rows.description: A student looks up to you and hangs on your words. Wise: guide without creating dependence and be honest about your limits. Harmful: using their admiration for favours.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: dependence, disillusionment, exploitation, favouritism, fear, gratitude

rows.description: You are scared to approach a strict professor. Wise: prepare, go to office hours and see them as people. Immature: avoiding until problems become bigger.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, dependence, disillusionment, exploitation, favouritism, gratitude

rows.description: You find a mentor is biased or petty. Wise: keep what they taught, update your view, and do not throw away the learning. Immature: cynicism toward all authority.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, dependence, exploitation, favouritism, fear, gratitude

rows.description: Grades or projects go to a favourite. Wise: gather facts, raise it through proper channels, and keep your own standards. Harmful: bitterness that damages your work.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, dependence, disillusionment, exploitation, fear, gratitude

rows.description: You need a letter and worry about asking. Wise: ask early and politely, give context on your work. Immature: expecting it as a right or dropping their name falsely.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, dependence, disillusionment, exploitation, favouritism, fear

rows.description: A mentor changed your direction. Wise: say thanks, pass on what you learn, and later pay it forward. Immature: forgetting them once you succeed.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, dependence, disillusionment, exploitation, favouritism, fear

rows.description: You wait for a mentor to tell you what to do. Wise: bring your own ideas and grow into independent judgement. Immature: outsourcing every decision.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, disillusionment, exploitation, favouritism, fear, gratitude

rows.description: A senior or guide uses your work, credit or time without fairness. Wise: name the unfairness politely, set limits and involve someone neutral if needed. It is not ungrateful to protect your work.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, dependence, disillusionment, favouritism, fear, gratitude

rows.description: A teacher or guide makes unwanted comments or touches. Wise: recognise it as wrong, keep records, and report to the internal committee or a trusted adult. It is never your fault.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, dependence, disillusionment, exploitation, favouritism, fear

rows.description: A senior shows you the ropes and you want to be like them. Wise: learn their thinking, not just copy their choices. Immature: imitating their style while ignoring your own path.
